name: i-dot-ai-core-github-actions
description: GitHub Actions reusable workflows for the I.AI platform. Hosts the Flue agent runtime for the generate-context workflow.

pinning_rationale: Per OQ-005, Flue is pinned to a specific version because the framework is experimental.

@flue/runtime and @flue/cli are pinned by exact version (0.6.2). package-lock.json captures the cryptographic integrity hash for each transitive dependency which provides reproducibility equivalent to a commit SHA pin.
valibot is pinned to 1.1.0 (exact). It is the structured-output validator the agent uses; non-major iteration is not desired during SLICE-007 calibration.
Bumps to any of these pins is a contract dispute against SLICE-006a, not a routine update.
